metadata.rationale: In live mode a call to an unregistered tool with no error callback still fails with the ValueError naming the tool.

metadata.citation: "If the callback returns a response, ADK emits that function response and continues; otherwise it keeps the old ValueError" (pull request message)
metadata.rationale: When the on_tool_error_callback returns nothing for a missing tool in live mode, the old ValueError must still be raised.

metadata.citation: "when the model calls an unregistered tool, ADK now runs on_tool_error_callback before failing" (pull request message); a registered tool is expected to just run
metadata.rationale: A registered tool called in live mode must run and return its result even though an on_tool_error_callback is attached.

metadata.citation: "Calls the functions and returns the function response event." (docstring of handle_function_calls_live in the base source)
